name: pipeline
description: co-think → write-issue → orchestrate: turn an idea into a grounded issue, then run the arc as a just-in-time loop — ground the next increment, ship it through isolated git worktrees, reconcile the rest against the tree it produced.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into a grounded issue, then run the arc to merge.
interface.longDescription: A just-in-time development pipeline. Turn an idea into a grounded GitHub issue, then run it to completion as a loop: ground the next dispatchable increment against the code, ship it off an integration branch through isolated git worktrees and dispatcher / implementer sub-agents, gate it, merge it, then re-ground what remains against the tree that increment actually produced.
defaultPrompt: Write up this plan as a grounded GitHub issue.
Decompose this issue into slices I can dispatch in parallel.
Orchestrate this issue through to merge.
